name: CMD-2
notes: CMD-2 shares the CMD collaboration record (collaboration:cmd, created with CMD-1). No technical description of the CMD-2 detector was retrieved.

summary.plain: The Cryogenic Magnetic Detector 2 at the VEPP-2M collider of the Budker Institute, which took data from 1992 to 2000. Among its results is a high-statistics measurement of the pion form factor between 0.6 and 1.0 GeV with 0.8% systematic uncertainty.
summary.technical: CMD-2 at VEPP-2M (0.36-1.4 GeV c.m.): commissioning 1984-1992, experiments 1992-2000; pion form factor measured for 0.6 < √s < 1.0 GeV with 0.8% systematic uncertainty from a data sample five times larger than the previous measurement (Phys. Lett. B 648 (2007) 28).
